_comment_kernel: 4.19 differs from Q3 5.10: selinux_state.enforcing @ +1 (disabled@0), task_struct.cred @ 0x7e8 (both from /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux). deltas = symbol - __platform_driver_register(0xffffff80087875e0), from vmlinux-to-elf of boot.img (KASLR-invariant). selinux_state=0xffffff8009db3ff8.
_comment_carrier: MERGED: only not-loaded module on QPro with a big-enough init (680B) is rdbg. It is built by build_credmod (enforcing=0 + status-page sync + cred-patch of the waiting shell) and loaded once. llcc_perfmon is already loaded on QPro so cannot be a carrier.
_comment_inject: rdbg is vendor_file: shell CANNOT read it under Enforcing, so it is poisoned by an init_array ctor injected into a same_process_hal_file lib mapped by trackingservice. libgralloc.qti (RELR init_array, 3744B exec gap) holds the 243-entry carrier diff table. The cfg IS shell-readable under Enforcing on QPro (recon step 8) so it is poisoned directly from shell, keeping the ctor to a single file.
